steps: 1. Identify the contract(s) with a customer
2. Identify the performance obligations in the contract
4. Allocate the transaction price to the performance obligations
5. Recognize revenue when (or as) the entity satisfies a performance obligation

criteria: Transfer of ownership by end of lease term
Purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised
Lease term is major part (>= 75%) of remaining economic life
Present value of lease payments equals or exceeds substantially all (>= 90%) of fair value
Underlying asset is of such specialized nature that it has no alternative use to lessor
ASC_842_Leases.balance_sheet_impact: Recognize Right-of-Use (ROU) Asset and Lease Liability.

Corporate_Tax_Safe_Harbor.estimated_tax_rules: To avoid underpayment penalties for corporations/S-Corps/LLCs, pay the lesser of: 100% of prior year tax liability (if prior year was 12 months and showed positive tax) or 90% of current year tax liability.

Forensic_Reconciliation_Rules.transposition_check: If trial balance difference is divisible by 9, investigate transposition errors ($54 vs $45).
Forensic_Reconciliation_Rules.sign_error_check: If difference is divisible by 2, check for wrong debit/credit posting direction.
